step1_analysis.description: A True-Single-Phase-Clock (TSPC) dynamic D-flip-flop with a hardwired D=1 input, typically used as one half of a Phase Frequency Detector (PFD) in a PLL. It outputs a low signal (QB) on the rising edge of CLK and is asynchronously reset to high by the RESET signal.

paper_reference.title: A 1.5-V 900-MHz Monolithic CMOS Fast-Switching Frequency Synthesizer for Wireless Applications

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard nominal supply for SKY130 1.8V devices.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Using 1.8V as per SKY130 PDK standard for these transistors, adjusted from the paper's 1.5V.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the DFF stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 30mW for the entire PLL, but this single DFF consumes much less (only dynamic switching power of a few nodes). Other PLL metrics like phase noise and VCO frequency are omitted as they cannot be measured on this sub-block.

operating_frequency.description: Operating frequency of the PFD (Reference frequency)

sky130_expected.calculation: Set by the testbench to match the paper's reference frequency.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper mentions a 25.6 MHz reference frequency for the PLL, which dictates the clock rate for this PFD stage.

delay_clk_qb.description: Propagation delay from CLK rising edge to QB falling edge

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the RC time constant of two series NMOS transistors (W=5u) discharging a ~20fF load capacitance.

delay_rst_qb.description: Propagation delay from RESET rising edge to QB rising edge

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the RC time constant of the NMOS discharging the internal node N0, followed by the PMOS charging the output node QB.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power consumption, operating frequency (clock period), and propagation delays of the PFD DFF.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PFD DFF Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N3 CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 QB N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 RESET GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 QB N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 RESET N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 CLK VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* 25.6 MHz clock -> period = 39.0625ns
VCLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 10n 100p 100p 10n 39.0625n)
VRST RESET 0 PULSE(1.8 0 5n 100p 100p 20n 39.0625n)

Cload QB 0 10f

.control
tran 10p 100n
let pwr_inst = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran power_avg avg pwr_inst from=10n to=49.0625n
meas tran delay_clk_qb trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(QB) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran delay_rst_qb trig v(RESET) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(QB) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran vdd_val max v(VDD)
meas tran clk_period trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=2
print power_avg delay_clk_qb delay_rst_qb vdd_val clk_period
quit
.endc
